slides.title: Qwen2.5 3B Instruct
slides.body: The model mxstudio was first benchmarked with (~35 tok/s on an RTX 3090). Strong general assistant quality while leaving VRAM to spare.

slides.title: What's special?
slides.body: Qwen2.5's mid-size open checkpoint: the full 18T-token pretraining + SFT + staged RL stack, delivering near GPT-3.5-class chat quality for many everyday tasks on a single consumer GPU. It is the practical ceiling of the 'small but serious' Qwen2.5 line before you jump to 7B+.
bullets: Post-training (SFT + RL) is a major share of perceived 'smartness'
3B is often enough for interactive assistants on consumer GPUs
License differences inside a family are easy to miss — always check

slides.title: How it's built
slides.body: Dense Qwen2 decoder-only transformer (GQA, SwiGLU, RoPE). Instruct checkpoint uses the Qwen chat template. License is more restrictive than the Apache 2.0 0.5B/1.5B variants — check the card before shipping.
bullets: Local coding help, longer answers, and demos where quality matters. Still small enough that MAX compile times stay reasonable on a 3090.
